title: SNAP - federal framework
facts: SNAP is a federal nutrition assistance program administered through state agencies under federal USDA rules.
Applicants generally apply through the SNAP agency in the state where they live; application methods and state procedures vary.
Federal SNAP eligibility uses household, income, resource and other rules, but states have options that can materially affect eligibility and administration.
A specific SNAP eligibility answer should therefore combine current federal rules with the applicant's state rules.
